name: Castle Rushen
scope: The historic Castle Rushen exterior in Castletown as seen in 2005, with its limestone keep, curtain wall, lower gatehouse and forecourt.

originalReview.notes: The exact harbour view shows the limestone curtain, tall crenellated keep, lower gatehouse and their relationship to the harbour road.

review.method: Exact Qualla native original and its first-party public-domain dedication
review.notes: Paul Dyer’s exact published Qualla photograph is a first-party public-domain original. The Commons original upload and early native release identify the author. The published June 2005 date follows a camera timestamp from the previous day. The old stereo card and interior exhibit photograph were excluded.
